notes:
Lead: VP Product (Marta Liu) and Head of Engineering (Ethan Cole). Current stack: production usages on another LLM API provider for chat, embeddings and reranking; high monthly spend, variable latency on peak. Primary goals: 1) reduce per-token cost and control latency variability; 2) keep prompt/response parity during migration; 3) progress to Dedicated for predictable throughput once parity validated.

POC specifics / ask: SE to provide compat wrappers for current provider's response schema (role/system->role mapping), example code snippets for streaming replacement, and a small SDK shim to validate function-calling parity. They want automated regression harness: run 10k recent customer prompts and flag delta on intent/slot extraction + token counts.

Engineering notes from deep-dive: "tokenization differences caused short hallucinations on earlier test set"; need quantization profile recommendations for their 8k-context product. Prefer Redwood-verified models with escape hatch to smaller cheaper variants for background tasks.

Commercial: procurement expects a clear Hosted -> Dedicated migration path and transparent committed capacity pricing. Asked for a pricing sheet showing Hosted credits vs Dedicated commit break-even at 6/12/24 months.

Quotes & paraphrase: "We can't tolerate >300ms p95 latency on live chat; secondarily, we need deterministic fallbacks during outages."

Suggested artifacts sent: migration deck, security FAQ, sample parity test harness (links above).
